newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA sees no big impact from planned strike.
newsitem.headline: ANA sees no big impact from planned strike.

text.p: Japan's second largest carrier All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) said on Wednesday that a planned strike by a labour union on November 29 would not have a significant impact on its revenues.
The union, which includes pilots and co-pilots, plans to stage a 24-hour strike on November 29.
But the company plans to operate flights as usual on the day by asking cooperation from pilots at the managerial level, an ANA spokesman said.

The union staged a one-day strike on November 19 over wage rises and bonuses, grounding 70 percent of the airline's daily domestic flights. It was the first serious strike at the company in 6-1/2 years.
The strike reduced the company's revenues by 1.2 billion yen, the spokesman said.
